## Property Gallery (PG)

Hero image with a thumbnail filmstrip, selection state, photo counter, and an honest empty state. Render-only and storage-neutral: the consumer supplies resolved URLs (Property Listing feeds it `photos.resolvedUrls`).

### Example

Mounted in the linked 14 Birchwood Lane listing.

### Non-goals

No lightbox/zoom or touch-swipe in v1. No upload — the field owns acquisition, the gallery owns viewing.

### Marketplace extension (2026-09-03)

Four modes: hero + filmstrip (default), grid (16:10 tiles with captions), fullscreen lightbox (dark backdrop, n/N counter, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape on a focused overlay — no document listeners), slideshow (same chrome, 4s auto-advance, pause/resume, opens paused under prefers-reduced-motion). New optional args: `@captions` (parallel array) and `@heroIndex` (fronts the gallery until the user clicks). Still render-only; ordering, hero choice and captions persist on the listing via Photo Organizer.
